question_responses.q1_intent_partner: honestly I'm kinda done with dating casually at this point — I want something real. I need someone who's emotionally available, not just texting back. like, checks in, talks about the future, actually shows up. communication is everything for me.
question_responses.q2_emotional_needs: when I'm stressed I tend to go quiet, and I need someone who can read that and not push me to talk right away. a simple 'hey I'm here' goes a long way. I feel most secure when my partner verbally reassures me — words of affirmation honestly matter more than I'd like to admit lol.
question_responses.q3_conflict_provides: I don't love conflict but I won't ghost it either. I usually need like an hour to settle, then I'll come back and talk it out. I try not to blame, I use 'I felt...' a lot. and when my partner is having a rough time I show up — I'll cook for them, check in more, just make sure they feel seen.
question_responses.q4_lifestyle_values: I do morning yoga most days — probably 5 or 6 times a week, it keeps me sane. I work in product design which is a lot of screen time so I really need that movement. weekends I'm usually hiking, at the farmers market, or in a bookstore. I eat plant-based and I love cooking. I care a lot about consistency — like doing small things well.
question_responses.q5_personality: my friends say I'm a lot, in a good way I hope. I'm pretty intense when I care about something, very organized, I overthink but I know it. I'm genuinely warm though — I love people, I notice the small things, and I think that makes me a good partner.
question_responses.q6_dealbreakers: smoking is a hard no — I have asthma so it's literally a health thing. any regular substance use is also off the table. and dishonesty in any form, even the small stuff. if I can't trust what you're telling me, we're done.
